explication: Sveltepress is a SvelteKit documentation and blog SSG toolkit. A site author configures the Vite integration and theme, writes Markdown/Svelte content, and builds pages with navigation, search, localization, and optional version snapshots; the CLI manages version plans and snapshots. The README also documents scaffolding, blog-theme features, Twoslash, alternate search providers, and generated llms.txt. The graph preserves those product branches; links not established by excerpts or README are omitted. Several core implementation files are indexed but unsampled, so their internals are not inferred.
